mustFix.title: Item 4 reads D-294's identical 'recorded leftover-join' predicate two opposite ways in one paragraph; on the broad reading Decision 2 trigger (b) fires on live bytes and the entry does not answer it
mustFix.where: coordinator-decisions.D-363.draft.md lines 141-158 (Eligibility item 4) and lines 266-272 (Alternatives, second bullet)
mustFix.whatTheDraftSays: Line 146-148: 'Under D-294 Decision 1 those sentences are custody at the D-295 recording heading and are not standing claims about live HEAD.' Lines 153-156: 'D-294 Decision 2's successor triggers govern a recorded leftover-join; preview-product-boundary-successor.v10 is a DESIGN-CONTRACT-CANDIDATE, not a leftover-join.'
mustFix.measured: D-294 Decision 1 opens 'In a recorded leftover-join, a sentence that names another lineage's leftover-join version ... is custody at that join's own recording heading.' D-294 Decision 2 opens 'A recorded leftover-join needs a successor when ...'. The subject-class predicate is word-for-word the same in both. The draft applies Decision 1 to preview-product-boundary-successor.v10 by casting it as 'that join' whose 'own recording heading' is D-295, and then denies Decision 2 on the ground that preview-product-boundary-successor.v10 is not a leftover-join. Both cannot be true of the same predicate.
mustFix.whyItLands: This is not a wording slip; it is the entry's whole answer to the 'require a preview-product-boundary-successor.v11 first' alternative, and it decides that alternative by asserting one reading and its negation. If the narrow reading is right, the draft's stated ground for discounting the four superseded currency sentences (Decision 1) is unavailable and item 4 rests on nothing it states. If the broad reading is right — and the register's own practice is the broad one: preview-product-boundary-successor.v10's purpose and joinCurrencyAudit.standing say it refreshed 42 cross-lineage citation sites 'under D-294 Decision 3', and D-295's heading records it 'as DR-117 leftover remasurement after D-294' — then Decision 2 reaches it and trigger (b) fires against live bytes. D-294 Decision 2 states the (b) test as mechanical and closes it 'A successor is required whenever any of those projected values changes'; it carries no favourable-direction exception.

Not byte-identical. mustFix.d314DoesNotCoverIt: D-314 item 1 (G1-117) reads 'Use the owner-controlled opening now against preview-product-boundary-successor.v10; require no further successor and no prior shared gate-2 entry, and allow G29/G30 authoring only after that opening.' The 'require no further successor' clause modifies the opening. That opening was performed at D-316 on 2026-08-29. The same item expressly contemplates that G29/G30 authoring follows the opening — and it is that authoring (D-317/D-339 for G30, D-318/D-342 for G29, remasured at D-340 and D-343) that changed the two partitions. D-314 item 1 is therefore not a standing waiver for this later gates-4/5 cycle, and the draft leans on it as one of three legs.
mustFix.remedy: State one consistent reading of D-294's 'recorded leftover-join' predicate as applied to preview-product-boundary-successor.v10 and defend it in the entry's own bytes — for example, that D-294 Decision 5's scope sentence generalises the currency *reading* while Decision 2's successor *obligation* stays on its named class — and, if the broad reading is taken, say expressly why trigger (b) firing on g29 and g30 does not require a preview-product-boundary-successor.v11 before gates 4 and 5. Alternatively drop the Decision 1 leg and rest item 4 solely on the live measurement recited in item 3, which is the ground that actually carries the argument.

mustFix.title: 'Every remaining member of both joins sits in qualificationAtNamedGate' is refuted by the bytes of the two joins the draft pins
mustFix.whatTheDraftSays: 'Both measure `summary.leftoverDesign` as the empty list. Every remaining member of both joins sits in `qualificationAtNamedGate`.'
mustFix.whyItLands: Four of six members in each join sit in `specifiedNotLeftover`, not `qualificationAtNamedGate`. The claim names the JSON bucket in backticks, so it is a byte-level assertion about each join's partition, and the bytes carry a third non-empty bucket the sentence denies exists. The error is not cosmetic: this sentence is the draft's gate-2 demonstration for DR-G29 and DR-G30, and the member it most misplaces is OBL-G29-FX-AUTHORING / OBL-G30-FX-AUTHORING, whose measured rideStanding is 'not-capable-of-riding as execution-only remainder' — expressly not qualification-at-named-gate. An entry that recites where fixture-authoring obligations now sit must recite the bucket the joins actually put them in.
mustFix.remedy: Replace with the measured partition, e.g. 'Both measure summary.leftoverDesign as the empty list; each join's remaining outstanding members, OBL-G29-HARNESS-SPEC / OBL-G29-EXECUTION and OBL-G30-HARNESS-SPEC / OBL-G30-EXECUTION, sit in qualificationAtNamedGate, and each join's other four members, including OBL-G29-FX-AUTHORING and OBL-G30-FX-AUTHORING, sit in specifiedNotLeftover.'
